jwt-decoder.about1Body: A JWT is only Base64Url-encoded for transport, so anyone can decode and read its contents without the secret key.
jwt-decoder.about2Body: All decoding happens 100% in your browser. The token is never sent to our servers.
jwt-decoder.about3Body: This tool focuses on inspecting the data. To verify validity you need the secret key.

hash-generator.tip1: A hash is one-way; you cannot "de-hash" it to recover the original text.
hash-generator.tip2: Everything is processed 100% in your browser (client-side); data is never sent to a server.
hash-generator.tip3: Use SHA-256 or SHA-512 for sensitive data security needs.
hash-generator.md5Desc: 128-bit hash (commonly used to check file integrity)
hash-generator.sha1Desc: 160-bit hash (legacy standard, not recommended for high security)
hash-generator.sha256Desc: 256-bit hash (very secure, the modern standard for SSL/Blockchain)

markdown-viewer.sample:
# Welcome to Markdown Viewer

Write **Markdown** in the left column and see the rendered result on the right.

## Supported features

- **Bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~
- Lists
- Tables
- Code blocks
- Blockquotes

### Table example

| Column A | Column B |
|----------|----------|
| Data 1 | Data 2 |
| Row 2, Col A | Row 2, Col B |

### Code example

```javascript
function helloWorld() {
  console.log("Hello, World!");
}
```

> This is a sample blockquote to test rendering.

image-to-base64.dragAndDropText: Drag & drop or click to select image
image-to-base64.supportedFormats: Supports PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, SVG (Max 5MB)
image-to-base64.base64IncreaseNotice: Base64 code is usually about 33% larger than the original file.
image-to-base64.embedInstruction: Use this code to embed the image directly into your code. Great for small icons or web background.

image-resizer.qualityNotice: Reducing quality will make the file size smaller.
image-resizer.tipsBody: To prevent distortion, always keep the **Lock Aspect Ratio** enabled. If you want to optimize page load speed, try reducing the quality to about 80-90%.

word-counter.placeholderInput: Enter or paste your text here to start counting automatically...
word-counter.privacyNotice: * Data is processed directly on your browser, ensuring absolute privacy.

case-converter.placeholderInput: Enter or paste your text here to start converting...
case-converter.tipSentence: • Sentence case automatically identifies periods to capitalize the start of a new sentence.
case-converter.tipCode: • Snake/Camel case helps clean up special characters for programming use.

text-to-slug.placeholderInput: Example: How to install latest React 2024
text-to-slug.whatIsSlugBody: A slug is the final part of a URL that describes the page content in an easy-to-understand way for both users and search engines (Google). A good slug must be lowercase, words separated by hyphens, and contain no special characters.

lorem-ipsum.tipParagraphs: Use Paragraphs to fill large text blocks.
lorem-ipsum.tipWords: Use Words or Sentences for titles or short description tags.
lorem-ipsum.tipChars: Use Characters when you need absolute precision for interface limits.

remove-line-breaks.trimLines: Trim spaces at start/end of lines

percentage-calculator.noteBody: All calculations are performed instantly (real-time). Results are rounded to 3 decimal places to ensure accuracy in finance and science.

bmi-calculator.infoBody: BMI (Body Mass Index) is an index used to determine if a person is underweight, normal weight, overweight, or obese. Note that BMI does not apply to pregnant women, bodybuilders, or the elderly with low muscle mass.

advice.underweight: You should focus on nutrition and exercise.
advice.normal: Excellent! Keep up your healthy lifestyle and current diet.
advice.overweight: You should manage your diet and increase physical activity.
advice.pre_obese: Body is starting to show signs of excess fat. Consider reducing carbs.
advice.obesity1: You need to start a weight loss program and seek nutritional counseling.
advice.obesity2: High risk of health issues. Consult a medical specialist.
advice.obesity3: Alarming health status. Immediate medical intervention needed.

bmi-calculator.inputWarning: Please enter weight and height to see the analysis result.

rule-of-three.typeDirectHint: A increases, B increases; A decreases, B decreases.
rule-of-three.typeInverseHint: A increases, B decreases; A decreases, B increases.
rule-of-three.tipDirect: • Direct: Cross-multiply (B × C) and divide by the side (A). Commonly used for: Pricing, ingredient weights...
rule-of-three.tipInverse: • Inverse: Horizontally multiply (A × B) and divide by the bottom (C). Commonly used for: Task completion time based on headcount...
